subject: Problem with zero constraints and equality constraints in group analysis...

messages.author: 1b81d9050f0dbe89
messages.subject: Problem with zero constraints and equality constraints in group analysis...
parts:
Hi Everyone,

I'm trying to estimate a model for three groups. One of the latent variables should have the following relationship

f1 =~ c(p1,p1,0)*x1 + c(p2,p2,0)*x2 + c(p3,p3,0)*x3

i.e. the two first groups should have the same parameter value while the third should be set to zero. Trying to estimate i get the following error:
 lavaan ERROR: wrong number of arguments in modifier (p1,p1) of element f1=~x1

One alternative would be to have:
f1 =~ c(p1,p1,d1)*x1 + c(p2,p2,d1)*x2 + c(p3,p3,d1)*x3
d1 == 1
 
Error in nlminb(start = start.x, objective = minimize.this.function, gradient = GRADIENT,  :
  'd' must be a nonempty numeric vector
lavaan WARNING: non-free parameter(s) in equality constraint(s): d1

The following works:
f1 =~ c(NA,NA,0)*x1 + c(NA,NA,0)*x2 + c(NA,NA,0)*x3

but then I do not get the equality constraints on the first two groups which I really need...

One idea which didnt work but might be nice is to have the ability to specify one model statement for each group and where using the same parameter labels would give the constraints between the models.

Do anyone have an idea how to do this in lavaan?

Thanks in advance!
Johan

messages.author: 5d4f9e7f97c21008
messages.subject: Re: Problem with zero constraints and equality constraints in group analysis...
parts:
Hi Johan,

You can include multiple modifiers for a parameter. So to estimate your model you would use both:
f1 =~ c(p1,p1,0)*x1 + c(p2,p2,0)*x2 + c(p3,p3,0)*x3
f1 =~ c(NA,NA,0)*x1 + c(NA,NA,0)*x2 + c(NA,NA,0)*x3

or 

f1 =~ c(p1,p1,0)*x1 + c(p2,p2,0)*x2 + c(p3,p3,0)*x3 + c(NA,NA,0)*x1 + c(NA,NA,0)*x2 + c(NA,NA,0)*x3

Alex
